label: Well-founded NECESSARY_2 grades are asymmetric on the same candidates
meaning: The well-founded relation includes the same classifier and relative necessity guards on both candidates. The standard asymmetry theorem excludes opposite edges under these guards. Strictness uses a single admitted world, a roster of natural-number candidates all existing and classified as concrete, and a strict grade MoreIn esse a b defined by b < a. This grade is asymmetric and has an endless ascent.
